ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Politics, Society, and Culture in Russia and the USSR, 1881-1938 Major themes in the history and historiography of late imperial and early Soviet Russia and the USSR from 1880s into the 1930s. Topics to be explored include social and cultural experience, diversity and difference, power and transgression, cultural construction and interpretation, gender, empire, capitalism, socialism, and revolution. Central to the course are questions of historical methodology and theory as well as of the interpretation of the Russian past.
